name: retinoid X receptor alpha
pathways: mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: RXRA encodes retinoic acid receptor RXR-alpha. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and mRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
